environment.device: cpu (2 vCPU cloud VM, no GPU)

scope: End-to-end verification that the code in this repository runs the published model correctly: clips were streamed from the public dataset and transcribed through src/hinglish_asr/model.py, the same code path used by transcribe.py, evaluate.py and app.py. The public dataset release is audio-only, so this run verifies transcription quality qualitatively and measures speed; WER/CER benchmarks live in benchmark_results.json.
